Sheike.fullPrice: Refund (instant or standard) or credit note. This includes items on a temporary promotion or bought with a discount code.
Sheike.sale: Marked-down sale items can only be returned for Sheike credit.
Sheike.other: Swimwear and bodysuits must keep the hygiene strip in place. In-store returns have a $400 limit per transaction.

Forever New.saleShort: no refund, gift card or exchange only
Forever New.fullPrice: Refund to your original payment method, or an exchange. Exchanges are in store only.
Forever New.sale: Sale items can't be returned for a refund if you change your mind. They can be exchanged for a Forever New gift card or another item.
Forever New.other: Items must be unworn with tags attached. Online orders older than 14 days can't be returned through the portal.
